patch.description:
Updates an account group. Every field is optional and only the fields present in the body are changed.

`parent_code` nests the group under another group of the same organization. It has three states: **absent** leaves the current parent untouched; **`null`** detaches the group and promotes it back to a root, together with any sub-groups hanging off it; a **group `id`** nests the group under that group. Nesting is structural only — it grants and revokes nothing, so moving a group leaves every existing permission untouched.

parent_code.description: The `id` of the group to nest this group under. Omit it to leave the parent unchanged; send `null` to detach the group and make it a root again. The parent must belong to the same organization and must not be the group itself or one of its descendants.

400.description:
Bad Request. The `code` field tells the reason:

- `PARENT_NOT_FOUND` — no group with that `parent_code` in this organization.
- `INVALID_PARENT` — the group was sent as its own parent.
- `PARENT_IS_DESCENDANT` — the target parent sits inside this group's own subtree, so the move would create a cycle.
- `MAX_NESTING_DEPTH` — the move would push the tree past the maximum depth of 20 levels.

messages: Account group [LATAM] is inside [Acme], so it cannot become its parent.

404.description: Not Found — no account group with that `account_group_id` in this organization.

parent_code.description: The `id` of the group this group is nested under. `null` for a root (top-level) group.
